config.elytra-vario.showLookaheadPitch.t: Pitch in [-89°, +89°] that maximizes the change in total energy (altitude + speed² / (2 × gravity)) over the lookahead duration, holding pitch and yaw constant. Searches whole degrees, then refines around the best. Uses the current velocity, yaw, and gravity in free-flight elytra physics, without rockets or collisions; Slow Falling effective gravity is not modeled. Only shown while gliding. Useful during the gain phase of a pump cycle. Leaves the display band when offscreen.
config.elytra-vario.showHoldPitch.toolti: Pitch whose next-tick flight-path angle equals the current velocity angle: -atan2(vertical velocity, horizontal speed). Searches from +89° nose-down toward -89° nose-up and refines the first root; hidden when there is no solution. Uses current yaw and gravity with the same free-flight model. Useful as a reference during the dive. Leaves the display band when offscreen.
config.elytra-vario.showOptimalPitch.too: Pitch in [-89°, +89°] that maximizes the change in total energy (altitude + speed² / (2 × gravity)) over one physics tick. Searches whole degrees, then refines around the best. Uses the current velocity, yaw, and gravity in free-flight elytra physics, without rockets or collisions; Slow Falling effective gravity is not modeled. Only shown while gliding. A greedy local optimum, not a whole-cycle optimum. Pegs gray at the band edge when offscreen.
config.elytra-vario.showVelocityPitch.to: Pitch of the latest velocity vector: -atan2(vertical velocity, horizontal speed), in degrees. Drawn in the center gap without a horizontal sideslip offset. Negative is upward. Only shown while gliding; pegs gray at the band edge.
config.elytra-vario.showFlightPath.toolt: Latest three-dimensional velocity direction projected through the current camera. Its vertical separation from the crosshair shows flight-path direction relative to view pitch; horizontal separation shows sideslip. Hidden at negligible speed or behind the camera. Pegs gray at the screen or band edge.
config.elytra-vario.lookaheadTicks.toolt: How long each candidate pitch is held before scoring total-energy change. Default: 20 ticks (one second at normal tick rate). Longer durations change the optimum and increase computation.
Eight hexadecimal digits: AARRGGBB (alpha, red, green, blue).

config.elytra-vario.chartAnchor.tooltip: A screen corner, or a side of Flight Stats. Attaching anchors the pair together, so the stats anchor and its offsets move both, and a side facing a screen edge pushes the panel in from that edge rather than taking the graph off it. Across the attachment the two line up with the edge the stats anchor names. Offsets are measured inward from the chosen corner, or away from the panel when attached. Center offsets are positive right and down.
